name: crossplane-mcp-server
description: Read-only access to a Crossplane control plane: inspect managed resources, composite resources, claims, packages, compositions, XRDs and their health.
long_description:
Crossplane MCP Server gives an AI agent safe, read-only visibility into a Crossplane control plane.

It connects through your existing kubeconfig and exposes five toolsets:

- **diagnostics** - overall control plane status, everything that is currently failing, stuck deletions, deletion protection and the installed Crossplane API surface.
- **packages** - installed providers, composition functions and configurations with their Installed/Healthy conditions and revisions.
- **compositions** - CompositeResourceDefinitions (XRDs), Compositions, their schemas, static validation and offline dry-run rendering of a function pipeline.
- **resources** - managed resources, composite resources (XRs) and claims with Ready/Synced conditions, composition trees and Kubernetes events.
- **config** - EnvironmentConfigs, DeploymentRuntimeConfigs, ManagedResourceDefinitions and activation policies.

Every tool is read-only: the server never creates, patches or deletes anything on the control plane.

kubeconfig.title: Kubeconfig File
kubeconfig.description: Path to the kubeconfig file used to reach your Crossplane control plane. Defaults to ~/.kube/config.
